plugins.name: solid-coder
plugins.description: Makes Claude write and review code against SOLID, DRY, KISS, YAGNI, Law of Demeter, Clean Code and the classic design patterns, with a review-and-fix command.

plugins.name: solid-coder-guard
plugins.description: Companion to solid-coder: after every Write/Edit, a separate model call checks the new code against SOLID, DRY, KISS, YAGNI, Law of Demeter and Clean Code, and feeds clear violations back to Claude.
